'''Paxton Rall''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who traveled with the [[Bloodhound (Togruta)|Bloodhound]], the [[Mauler (Rodian)|Mauler]], and "Friendly" [[Rin]].<ref name="swtor.com" />

==Behind the scenes==
Paxton Rall appears in the [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. He can be found on [[Carrick Station]], [[Vaiken Spacedock]], [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]],<ref name="Alderaan">{{TORcite|type=location|[[Shining Star cantina]]|[[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]}}</ref> [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="Coruscant">{{TORcite|type=location|[[Drunkard's Vote]]|[[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]}}</ref> [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]],<ref name="Dromund Kaas">{{TORcite|type=location|[[Nexus Room]]|[[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]}}</ref> [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]],<ref name="Balmorra">{{TORcite|type=location|[[Farnel Outpost]] Command Center| [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]}}</ref> [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]],<ref name="Corellia">{{TORcite|type=location|[[Shipwright Auxiliary Spaceport]]|[[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]}}</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Rishi]], and [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Paxton Rall can be used as a companion by players who bought a subscription before [[December 14]], [[2018]].<ref name="swtor.com" /> Paxton Rall has since been made made unlockable for all players as part of Galactic Season 1, following the release of [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|Update 6.3 "The Dark Descent"]].<ref name="Galactic Season">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210426-1|text=Galactic Season 1: The Stranger from Kubindi}}</ref>
